engagement.subtitle: Example Client — Production API
engagement.confidentiality: This document contains confidential security findings. Distribution is restricted.

narrative: Transilience AI assessed the Example API. 2 findings are reported (1 High, 1 Medium) after blind validation.
key_risks: IDOR on /orders (HIGH). Order records are returned by sequential id with no ownership check.
positives: JWTs are RS256-signed; no token-forgery primitive observed.

findings.title: IDOR on /orders/{id} — any order readable
findings.description: The endpoint returns any order by numeric id with no binding to the authenticated user.
findings.impact: Cross-customer disclosure of order PII at scale via id enumeration.
findings.recommendation: Bind every order id to the authenticated principal server-side; use unguessable ids.

poc.description: Authenticate as user A and note their own order id (1000).
Request a different user's order id directly, reusing user A's token.
Response returns user B's order — name, address and total — confirming the missing object-level authorization.

findings.title: Outdated nginx 1.18.0 (multiple CVEs)
findings.description: Server banner discloses nginx 1.18.0 with known CVEs.
findings.impact: Known-vulnerable component; banner also aids fingerprinting.
findings.recommendation: Upgrade nginx; suppress the version banner.

poc.description: Fetch the response headers from the host.
The Server header discloses the exact version: `Server: nginx/1.18.0`.
